data.body:
RCA/final implementation note before close.

Confirmed mechanism: close_precheck emits completion sidecars through completion_sidecar.emit(result, material=None, repo_root=repo_root), and transition_close standalone verify-completion used the same material=None emit path; completion_bundle built atomic PASS payloads directly. The verifier already attached current plan material plus completion_read_basis (including receipt_digest) before emission, but build_payload ignored verdict["material_fingerprint"] when the explicit material argument was None.

Defect origin: caused_by olivine-married-kodiakbear / 24ec-c291-9f47-47fd, commit 2830f30f58ea61807ad96adc1257be04bebd3fa2, by scope-of-work: its plan promised durable completion FAIL verdicts including the ticket material fingerprint at verify time, but the implementation passed material=None and left the persisted record unattributable.

Fix: completion_sidecar now derives a composite sha256-16 material_fingerprint from the existing plan material fingerprint plus pinned completion_read_basis and prefetch manifest identifiers; PASS/FAIL sidecars carry material_basis and verifier_version. completion_precheck threads the prefetch manifest through completion_reconcile, atomic PASS passes repo_root to the builder, and completion gate_error_v1 records get completion-only material/version enrichment while plan/code-review ERROR records stay unchanged. Existing sidecars/readers are untouched and records without material/version remain readable as unknown-era legacy data.

Validation: RED oracle tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py::test_fail_emit_carries_pinned_material_fingerprint_and_verifier_version failed before the fix on missing material_basis/version, then passed. Mutation tooth reintroduced the builder omission and that held-out test failed, killing the mutant. Targeted regression suite passed (110 tests), make lint passed, make typecheck passed. Full local make test was attempted but stopped after unrelated pre-existing macOS safe.bareRepository=explicit failures in atomic bare-remote tests; the relevant non-remote atomic sidecar test passed, and Gerrit CI later supplied Verified+1.

Step-7 parity sweep: Serena/grep found completion_sidecar.emit at close_precheck, transition_close, tests/helpers; build_payload direct production caller completion_bundle; ERROR call sites gate_dispatch preflight and completion_failures mid-run through gate_error_sidecar; epic bug-screen tally uses a different schema and is N/A. All completion verdict/error paths are now covered or intentionally N/A.

Landed: Gerrit change 2473, commit 19d91550cf312057e9c091a7c39df595be500497 on origin/main, with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1; no unresolved comments.
